[Regent’s Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy)

## Appearance

Mabel is a striking woman with dark eyes.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Mabel Colby is a striking, dark-eyed young woman with a heart filled with imaginative and colorful dreams. She harbors a deep fear of her small, delightful haven being shattered, which would force her and other inexperienced youths back into the harsh environment of boardinghouses.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)_

## History

Mabel Colby attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) alongside her friend [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and went on to work continuously as a schoolteacher after her time there. Having spent a dreadful night in a leaking country farmhouse while instructing in an isolated rural school, she grew weary of her position. With limited financial means of her own, Mabel sent a letter to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and Mabel lease a house together for the upcoming school year. The group, eventually joined by [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) and [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), settled comfortably into Tabby's Place in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris). While residing there, Mabel expressed frustration over rising prices as the housemates managed their modest living expenses. During a rainy night spent studying for examinations, Mabel and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) combated their fatigue by reviewing old, dramatic [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) tales.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P1](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0001), [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Friend P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), +12 more_

## Quotes

> "Cressy, you make no sense to me. It is obvious you are intentionally encouraging him, yet you are fully aware that your intentions are not serious."
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Charming P22](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0022)

> "My fear was that they would return, which would shatter our delightful small haven here, casting us unfortunate, inexperienced young ones back into the harsh realm of boardinghouses."
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "Oh, Nell, my intellect concurs with what you say. Nevertheless, my spirit continues to be gloomy and lacking in creative spark. Rainy evenings perpetually leave me feeling filthy and unkempt."
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Opens P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)

> "Nothing appears to have any value. Even my thoughts are ancient. I’ve already pondered every single one. What purpose does life serve anyway, Nell?"
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

> "Cressida Lindsay! I never considered you completely heartless. To think you declared that you would delight in breaking a man’s heart!"
>
> — Mabel Colby — [v3 ch.Charming P20](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mabel-colby--nell-harcourt.md)

Mabel and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) are close friends and driven scholars who balanced academic rivalry and camaraderie while studying at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). Mabel takes the initiative in their bond, writing to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to propose that they, along with [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), lease a house together at Tabby's Place for the upcoming school year. They live together harmoniously alongside their housemates, sharing cozy evenings where they listen to letters read aloud and attend to their studies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +16 more_

- Friend of — close friends and driven scholars  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVI. The Glory and the Dream P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), +3 more</sub>

### [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-euphemia--mabel-colby.md)

[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) is Mabel's aunt who moves into Tabby's Place to live alongside Mabel and her housemates. She provides a comfortable domestic presence while reassuring the young women that she will not strictly supervise them. Mabel lives in the shared household with her aunt as they go about their daily routines, though she occasionally frets over practical household matters like rising prices.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023), +8 more_

- Relative of — aunt (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Relationships P23](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0023)</sub>

### [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/honora-hollis--mabel-colby.md)

Mabel and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) are school friends who originally studied together at Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy). Looking forward to the upcoming academic year, Mabel writes to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) suggesting that she, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) co-lease a residence, which ultimately leads to them living together at Tabby's Place. As housemates, they share domestic life, practice their cooking skills, and prepare alongside one another for their upcoming examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P5](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Regent’s P8](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0008), +12 more_

- Friend of — school friends from Regent's Academy (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
